purpose: Teach: 高架/岩石/邸宅/蜘蛛/蝉/コスモス/重油/広辞苑

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと高架下を歩いたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, we used to walk under the elevated highway together.
lines.style: Soft, faraway voice. Gentle opening, like surfaces of old memories. Slow, deliberate pace. Slight upward lift at the end — inviting her into the memory, not just telling it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、岩石コレクションをお持ちだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — your grandfather did collect rocks, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, almost musical cadence. Gently correcting the thread, bringing it back with fondness. A small smile in the voice. The cadence of someone who loves him enough to redirect without making him feel lost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが古い邸宅で写真を撮られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he had his photograph taken at that old mansion.
lines.style: Same gentle, wistful baseline. Quieter this time — more internal. The memory slightly hazier, or perhaps sadder. A pause-weight before 'old mansion,' like he's seeing it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お庭の蜘蛛の巣をご観察されてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — you used to watch the spider webs in the garden so carefully, didn't you?
lines.style: Patient, loving redirection again. She's gently untangling his thread and offering her own. Not correcting him — completing him. Warm, steady voice. The rhythm of someone who's done this dance many times.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは夏の蝉の声が好きでらした
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he loved the sound of the cicadas in summer.
lines.style: Even softer now. Almost whispered, like he's drifting deeper into memory. Dreamy quality. The 'loved' carries a small, tender weight. Trailing-off at the end, as if he's listening to them even now.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お庭にコスモスを毎年植えられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — you planted cosmos flowers in the garden every single year, didn't you?
lines.style: Bright, gentle warmth underneath. She's offering him beauty he created, not memories he's chasing. Clearer voice now, grounded in love rather than correction. The affection is almost playful — I remember what you did, even if you're lost in what your father did.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが重油タンカーの仕事の話をされた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to talk about working on those heavy oil tankers.
lines.style: Lower tone now, more grounded. A different quality — respect, perhaps slight gravity. The work matters. His voice settles on 'tankers' — concrete, real, a thing his father actually did with his hands and his life.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、書斎に広辞苑を置いてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — you kept that big Kojien dictionary right there on your study shelf, didn't you?
lines.style: Warmth with a subtle close — she's bringing him back gently. Voice becomes slightly more present, less distant. Still tender, but with an undertone of 'I'm here, I see what you built,' as if she's anchoring him. The final 'dear' is a gentle hand on his arm.
